page: Microsoft Azure L32ps_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an ARM64 processor architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of memory per core. The configuration operates without hardware GPU accelerators.

Storage capabilities feature an integrated local NVMe solid-state drive with a total capacity of 7679 GB, along with compatibility for Azure Premium Storage. The extensive local NVMe configuration provides low-latency and high-throughput data access on the physical host, circumventing external network storage overhead for high-bandwidth disk operations. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The architectural combination of an ARM64 compute subsystem, an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, and dense local NVMe storage delivers high resource density for data-heavy production tasks. Tradeoffs include the requirement for ARM-compatible binary deployments and the non-persistent nature typical of direct-attached temporary NVMe volumes. The instance is suited for transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, search engines, and real-time caching layers.
